annotations.title: Find lenders by industry and state

description: Named lenders and programs for an industry, optionally filtered by state and product and ranked cheapest-suitable first for the bands given. Returns institution, program, products, geography, broker path, submission channel and the source URL. Not an offer; lenders decide.

industry.description: Industry in a few words (e.g. "restaurants", "trucking", "dental practice"). No company names.
